verses.1: And the people of Jerusalem chose Ahaziah, their youngest son, to be king. For all the former kings had been killed; the great man who came in the morning hours to the camp became king instead. Ahaziah, son of Jehoram, became king over Judah.
verses.2: At the age of forty-two, he became king. He ruled for one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Atalia, daughter of Amri.
verses.3: He also followed the ways of the house of Ahau, because his mother advised him to take over the leadership.
verses.4: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Ahab had done. He received advice from those who advised him after his father’s death, so that they could destroy him.
verses.5: Also, by their advice, Jerahmeh son of Ahaziah, king of Israel, went out to fight against Ahaziah, king of Judah. They set up ambushes in Gilad, and they captured Jerahmeh.
verses.6: And he went back to Israel to recover from his injuries. The wounds he received during the battle against King Ahaz of Judah were very severe. Azariah, son of Jehoram king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram, son of Ahab, in Israel. He was very ill at that time.
verses.7: And from God came the command to go to Yoram. When they arrived there, they went with Yoram to Jehu, son of Nimshi, who was chosen by Yahweh to destroy the house of Ahaz.
verses.8: And when He judged, He met with the house of Ahava. He found the leaders of the Jews and the sons of Ahiahaziah, who served Ahiahaziah. And He killed them.
verses.9: And he sought Ahaziah. He caught him and he was hidden in a place where no one could find him. Then he brought him before Jehu. Jehu killed him, and they buried him. For Ahaziah said that he sought Jehovah with all his heart. But Ahaziah’s house had no strength to rule as king.
verses.10: And when Vahaliyah, or Ahaziah, saw that her son had died, she rose up and spoke to all the descendants of the king in the house of Judah.
verses.11: And Jehosaphat took the daughter of the king, Yoash son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the dead children of the king. She gave him up along with his wife to the raiders. Jehosaphat, the daughter of the king, hid them in a hiding place. The priest Yehoyada knew that she was the sister of Ahaziah. But she wasn’t killed.
verses.12: And they were in the house of God for six years. Then, Ester became queen over the land.
